parsed_json.up: Select compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, standard type, standard relation, standard value, standard units, activity comment, target ChEMBL ID, target name, and target organism. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, then to target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures on molregno as an INNER JOIN to require structures. Join docs on doc_id to get PubMed ID and DOI. Join compound_records on record_id to retrieve compound key. Filter for human Pim-1 kinase by target name and organism, and for IC50 standard type. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, standard type, standard relation, standard value, standard units, activity comment, target ChEMBL ID, target name, and target organism.
